name: signature-and-body
description: Upstream adds an optional greeting parameter; the change rewrites the body to clean up the name. The resolution needs the new signature and the new body together (one combined line).

plan.title: Clean up names in greetings
plan.intent: Names arrive with stray spaces and lower-case initials; greet() should trim them and capitalize the first letter.

plan.title: Custom greeting word
plan.intent: Let callers choose the greeting word; it defaults to Hello.
